findings.summary: cors({ origin: '*', credentials: true }) is browser-rejected for cookie auth per ARCHITECTURE §5.4; SPA cannot send HttpOnly session cookie.
findings.suggested_fix: Read CORS_ORIGIN from env (single trusted SPA host) and pass it as `origin` to cors(); keep `credentials: true`. Browsers ignore Allow-Credentials when Allow-Origin is '*'.

findings.summary: buildApp(_env) accepts env but discards it; db/tokens resolve env via the module-level singleton, so the parameter is decorative not a DI seam.
findings.suggested_fix: Either thread env into createDb/createAuthService/tokens factories so tests can inject test config, or drop the env parameter and rename to `buildApp()` documenting env as a process singleton.

findings.summary: loadEnv(process.env) at boot duplicates shared/env.ts:26 which also eagerly calls loadEnv() at import time; env validation runs twice.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the eager `export const env = loadEnv()` from shared/env.ts (recommended — restores DI for tests) OR drop the explicit loadEnv() call in main.ts. Both run today.

findings.summary: shutdown handler awaits pool.end inside server.close callback but does not register an error path or timeout; a hung pg pool blocks SIGTERM indefinitely.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap pool.end() with a timeout (e.g. Promise.race against setTimeout(5_000)) and call process.exit(1) on rejection so SIGTERM cannot hang the container.
